split.selection: Three predeclared complete test sequences by default; optional contiguous prefixes. Not the complete challenge test set

scope: Real annotated traffic, predeclared UA-DETRAC subset. Not a full UA-DETRAC challenge score or its PR-MOTA protocol.

methodology.class_mapping: COCO car/motorcycle/bus/truck -> vehicle; mirror collapses vehicle subclasses
methodology.ignore_policy: COCO crowd IoA for detection AP; tracking removes unmatched predictions with ignored-region IoA > 0.5 after valid GT matching at IoU 0.5
methodology.detection_ap: pycocotools COCOeval, conf floor 0.001, NMS IoU 0.7, IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95, maxDets=100
methodology.precision_recall: confidence 0.25, class-merged maximum-cardinality matching at IoU 0.5
methodology.tracking: Production YOLOTracker.infer, all frames, new persistent tracker per sequence; TrackEval official combine_sequences
